references.context: Hit the center Razor Crest target hard enough to register. Use BOBA and FETT to select Ice Spider or Pirates.
references.label: Razor Crest target and ramp
references.description: The direct target is below the ship at the center ramp entrance.

references.context: Shoot the left scoop to start the prepared Mission.
references.label: Mission and Foundry scoop
references.description: The left-center scoop starts Missions and enters the Foundry.

references.context: Shoot the left ramp to the upper playfield. Complete all six purple targets to add a ball.
references.label: Left ramp
references.description: The left ramp feeds the upper Encounter area on Premium and LE.

references.context: Complete the three blue Scope shots: U-turn or reverse scoop, the left 2x standup, and the right ramp.
references.label: Right ramp
references.description: The green right ramp is the right-side Scope collect and a Mission qualifier.

references.context: Complete the left three-target bank to light Hunter at an inlane.
references.label: Hunter target bank
references.description: The three orange standups are on the left side.

references.context: During multiball, hit both green BOBA and FETT targets.
references.label: BOBA and FETT targets
references.description: The two green standups are beside the center-right lanes.
